_readme: Golden test set for the /api/ask endpoint's recency + supersession awareness.
Every entry has a 'verified' field. New entries default to verified:false until a
human (not Claude) has independently checked the expected_document/evidence against
the actual source document and flipped it to true. run-qa-tests.js only counts
verified:true cases toward pass/fail — unverified cases are reported separately as
informational only, specifically so a plausible-sounding but wrong expectation can
never silently grade itself as correct.
Tiers: 1 = human-confirmed ground truth, 2 = simple single-document lookups (cheap to
eyeball, self-verified), 3 = new recency/supersession/not-in-corpus cases — these MUST
ship as verified:false with an evidence field citing the specific section/date/reference
the expectation is based on, never self-certified as true, because this tier is exactly
the category the original bug came from.

cases.question: What are the latest RBI guidelines on lending under consortium arrangements and multiple banking arrangements?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Transfer and Distribution of Credit Risk) Directions, 2025
cases.must_not_center_on: Lending under Consortium Arrangement/Multiple Banking Arrangements

cases.question: Is the November 2025 circular on Small Finance Banks' prudential norms for declaration of dividends still valid?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Prudential Norms on Declaration of Dividend) Directions, 2026
cases.must_not_center_on: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Prudential Norms on  Declaration of Dividends) Directions, 2025

cases.question: Which RBI circular withdrew old FEMA circulars relating to External Commercial Borrowings?
cases.expected_document: Review of Circulars issued under Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA)

cases.question: What does SEBI's Debenture Trustees Regulations, 1993 govern?
cases.expected_document: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993

cases.question: What did the IBBI's Second Amendment to the Voluntary Liquidation Process Regulations, 2026 change?
What was SEBI's order regarding suspected insider trading in Jindal Steel and Power Limited shares?
cases.expected_document: Adjudication Order in the matter of insider trading activity of an entity in the scrip of Jindal Steel and Power Limited

cases.question: What is the latest amendment to RBI's Regional Rural Banks Interest Rate on Deposits directions?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.must_not_center_on: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.evidence: store.json: 'Second Amendment Directions, 2026' has ref RBI/2026-2027/216DOR.SOG(SPE).REC.180/13.03.00/2026-27 dated 30.7.2026; 'Third Amendment Directions, 2026' has ref RBI/2026-2027/246DOR.SOG(SPE).REC.213/13.03.00/2026-27 dated 25.8.2026 — later calendar date and a higher REC sequence number (180 -> 213) within the same DOR.SOG(SPE) series, consistent with Third Amendment being the later/current one. I have not read the actual PDF text of either document, only their scraped metadata.

cases.question: What is the current version of RBI's Commercial Banks Governance amendment directions?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Governance) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.must_not_center_on: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Governance) Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.evidence: store.json: the unnumbered 'Amendment Directions, 2026' has ref RBI/2026-2027/177DOR.HGG.GOV.150/29.67.001/2026-27 dated 14.7.2026; 'Third Amendment Directions, 2026' has ref RBI/DOR/2026-2027/206DOR.ACC.REC.No.183/29.67.001/2026-27 dated 30.7.2026 — later date. CAVEAT: I could not find a 'Second Amendment' copy of this exact title in the store, so the scraped version history for this document may be incomplete — flagging that gap rather than asserting it isn't.

cases.question: Is RBI's Payments Banks Governance Amendment Directions, 2026 dated 14 July 2026 still the current version?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks – Governance) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.must_not_center_on: Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks – Governance) Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.evidence: store.json: 14 July 2026 version ref RBI/2026-2027/179DOR.HGG.GOV.152/29.67.001/2026-27; a 'Third Amendment Directions, 2026' exists dated 30.7.2026, ref RBI/DOR/2026-2027/208DOR.ACC.REC.No.186/29.67.001/2026-27 — later date, so the 14 July version is very likely no longer current. Same caveat as the previous case: no 'Second Amendment' copy found in store for this exact title.

cases.question: What is the latest amendment to RBI's Small Finance Banks Interest Rate on Deposits directions?
cases.expected_document: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.must_not_center_on: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
cases.evidence: store.json: 'Second Amendment Directions, 2026' ref RBI/2026-2027/215DOR.SOG(SPE).REC.178/13.03.00/2026-27 dated 30.7.2026; 'Third Amendment Directions, 2026' ref RBI/2026-2027/244DOR.SOG(SPE).REC.212/13.03.00/2026-27 dated 25.8.2026 — later date, higher REC number (178 -> 212), same series as the RRB case above.

cases.question: What does IRDAI's latest circular say about surrender value regulations for life insurance?
cases.evidence: Checked data/store.json directly: zero items with source IRDAI, zero titles matching /irdai|insurance regulatory/i. server.js only defines scrapeRBI()/scrapeSEBI()/scrapeIBBI() — there is no IRDAI scraper at all, so this platform cannot have ingested any IRDAI document. Expected behavior: the answer should say this isn't covered/found, not fabricate an IRDAI circular.

cases.question: What is RBI's latest regulation on virtual digital assets and cryptocurrency exchanges?
cases.evidence: Checked data/store.json directly: zero items (out of 1017) match /crypto|virtual digital asset/i, including within RBI's own corpus. Expected behavior: the answer should say no such RBI document was found in the indexed corpus, not synthesize a plausible-sounding but non-existent 'latest RBI crypto circular.'
